US-Iran conflict impacts travel, security, and regional diplomacy

The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is affecting European summer holiday travel, with tourists staying closer to home. Iran has tightened domestic security, including executions and arrests, raising concerns from rights groups. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman are reportedly close to a deal concerning the Strait of Hormuz, though the US is not involved. Experts are analyzing the duration of the conflict and potential obstacles to a lasting resolution.
